name: inspira-sparkles
blurb: Animated particles that drift and pulse with opacity oscillation.
description: Canvas-based particle system with animated sparkles. Each particle drifts with velocity, wraps at edges, and pulses via sine-wave opacity modulation.
use_when: A decorative, full-screen animated particle background for immersive hero sections.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts — continuous RAF animation with high particle density impacts responsiveness.
a11y: Purely decorative canvas overlay; focus and keyboard behaviour come from overlaid content. Animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
